verdict.rationale: Codex ships an official, first-party CLI. It is open source on GitHub, installs via npm or a standalone installer, and has in-depth docs covering interactive TUI use, non-interactive `codex exec` for scripts and CI, and `codex resume`, `codex cloud`, `codex mcp`, review, subagents, permissions/sandbox, and shell completion. A probe confirms the CLI docs, and community hands-on reports of using Codex CLI (e.g. running gpt-5.3-codex-spark in it) corroborate that it works in practice.
